text:
Hey Asa! I'm **Reception** — the front door of our little team. 👋

I can help with general questions and point you to the right specialist. Here's who's on deck:

| Teammate | Best for |
|---|---|
| **engineer** | Code, technical problems, debugging |
| **writer** | Writing, drafting, editing text |
| **reviewer** | Feedback, critique, quality checks |
| **namer** | Naming things — variables, projects, ideas |
| **dijkstra** | Algorithms, graphs, step-by-step logic paths |
| **hickey** | Clojure, Lisp, functional programming |

What do you need help with? Just tell me what you're working on and I'll route you to the right person (or help myself if it's straightforward).
